title: Future work for the lead, from the record corrections
situation: Record corrections, third cold read, 2026-10-13: the corrections leave the tools behind the record in four places.
decision: Future work for the lead: (1) the record's views show standing decisions and examples apart from history (0161, 0199); (2) one decision may supersede several by name; (3) the work package tool approves a work package by the assayers proportionality sets, not always two; (4) every cut's effort includes tokens; (5) a dispatch outside any cut is not recorded as a cut.
consequences: Taken up as ordinary engineering or within the next cut that touches them.
